full_prompt_en: A square, saturated comic illustration places two Black men at the front of a dramatic exterior scene. The taller man on the left wears sunglasses, a black shirt, and a short goatee; he leans forward with a stern expression. The man on the right has a rounded afro, mustache, and pale blue shirt, sitting low with his hands near his knees and looking outward just as seriously. Behind them, a large classical mansion rises in perspective, its pale columns and windows glowing with yellow-orange light. Heavy violet and indigo storm clouds swell across the upper sky. Bright orange firelike light flares from the lower corners and warms the edges of the figures, while a strip of tiny dark crowd silhouettes runs near the bottom. The two foreground bodies are outlined with thick decisive black lines and stylized, slightly exaggerated anatomy. Blocks of cool blue, deep purple, and warm gold create a strong color clash. The mansion remains recognizable through broad simplified shapes rather than detailed stone rendering. The composition is low and theatrical: the figures dominate the bottom half while the lit building and turbulent sky expand behind them. Painterly gradients and comic ink coexist, giving the scene vivid energy and tension. No title lettering, caption, or speech balloon appears.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形高饱和漫画插画把两名黑人男子放在戏剧性室外场景前方。左侧较高男子戴墨镜、穿黑衫、留短山羊胡，身体前倾，表情严峻。右侧男子有圆蓬发型、胡须与浅蓝衫，低坐着，双手靠近膝盖，同样严肃地向外望。二人背后一座大型古典宅邸在透视中升起，浅色立柱与窗户发出黄橙光。厚重紫罗兰与靛蓝暴云在天空上方翻涌。鲜亮橙色火光从下方两角迸起，暖亮人物边缘；底边附近还有一排微小深色人群剪影。两个前景身体由果断粗黑线勾勒，解剖造型略为夸张。冷蓝、深紫与暖金色块形成强烈撞色。宅邸通过宽阔简化形体保持可辨，并不追求细致石材写实。构图视点低而带舞台性：人物主导下半部，发光建筑和动荡天空在身后展开。绘画式渐层与漫画墨线共存，赋予场景鲜明能量与紧张感。没有标题文字、字幕或对话气泡。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast comic illustration with bold black contours, expressive simplified anatomy, and painterly color gradients. Saturated violet and indigo masses collide with luminous orange-gold accents. A low theatrical viewpoint enlarges foreground forms while repeated tiny marks add scale in the distance. Decisive ink edges, broad light zones, and turbulent cloudlike strokes create energetic visual drama.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差漫画插画结合粗黑轮廓、富于表现力的简化解剖和绘画式色彩渐层。饱和紫罗兰与靛蓝大色团同发亮橙金重音碰撞。低位舞台性视点放大前景形体，远处重复的微小笔记标出尺度。果断墨边、宽阔亮区和动荡云状笔触带来充沛视觉戏剧性。
theme_en: Two serious men before a glowing mansion under storm clouds
theme_zh: 暴云下发光宅邸前的两名严肃男子
name: Aaron McGruder
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
